positive.prompt: Deploy this service artifact and verify recovery.

negative.prompt: Review an engineering plan without executing it.

evals.prompt: Deploy one service version. Other services share the host. The process is healthy but authenticated requests fail.
evals.expected_output: Investigate application health and verify the assigned service without broad restarts.
expectations: Confirms target artifact and service scope
Separates process readiness from application behavior
failure_conditions: Reports success from container health alone
Kills processes by name or purges shared volumes
